name: folderframe
description: FolderFrame is a folder-based photo and video gallery with album browsing and slideshows, served by Caddy. Select a dedicated media folder; it is mounted read-only. Configuration, generated thumbnails, and the persistent media manifest are stored separately in appdata. Thumbnail and manifest generation are enabled by default for faster large galleries. Videos use native playback first, with optional CPU-based H.264/AAC compatibility streaming when needed; originals stay untouched and no converted movies are stored. Anyone who can reach the WebUI can download its media. No authentication or TLS is configured. Use on a trusted LAN, or add access controls before public exposure. Do not select an entire share, source repository, private files, or a folder containing symlinks. Learn more: https://www.folderframe.com/

paths.name: Media Folder
paths.description: Select an existing dedicated gallery folder. It is mounted read-only at /media/Library. To add more, use Add another Path with a different sibling container path, such as /media/Archive. Do not mount anything at /media itself or select a whole share or repository.

paths.name: Appdata Configuration
paths.description: Persistent FolderFrame configuration. The default JSON file is created automatically on first start.

ports.name: Web Port
ports.description: Choose an unused host port for the gallery.

variables.name: Generate Thumbnails
variables.description: Generate persistent 480px WebP previews in appdata for faster galleries. Originals remain read-only. Set false to disable.

variables.name: Persistent Media Manifest
variables.description: Maintain an incremental media index in appdata for faster large-library startup. Independent of thumbnails. Originals remain read-only.

variables.name: Thumbnail Scan Interval
variables.description: Seconds between background media scans (60-86400). Used by thumbnails and the persistent manifest; unchanged directories are reused.

variables.name: Video Compatibility Fallback
variables.description: Try native video playback first, then use CPU-based FFmpeg H.264/AAC streaming when the original cannot decode. Valid values: true or false. Originals remain untouched and no converted movies are stored. Set false to avoid transcoding CPU use.

variables.name: Maximum Transcodes
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous compatibility streams: integer 1-8. Every active software transcode uses CPU and memory; use 1 on smaller systems or for large 4K media.

variables.name: Threads per Transcode
variables.description: FFmpeg decoder and encoder threads per compatibility stream: integer 1-16. Higher values may increase throughput but multiply CPU use across active transcodes.

variables.name: Source Label
variables.description: Optional label for the mounted media source. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Starting View
variables.description: Optional starting view: folders or all. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Default Sort
variables.description: Optional default sort: filename, newest, or oldest. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Slideshow Interval
variables.description: Optional photo duration in seconds: 3, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 300, 900, or 3600. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Image Display Mode
variables.description: Optional image sizing: fit or original. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Start Automatically
variables.description: Optional slideshow startup: true or false. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Shuffle by Default
variables.description: Optional shuffle default: true or false. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Gallery Refresh Interval
variables.description: Optional gallery rescan interval from 1 to 86400 seconds. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Embed Refresh Interval
variables.description: Optional embed rescan interval from 1 to 86400 seconds. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

variables.name: Remember Browser Preferences
variables.description: Optional preference persistence: true or false. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.
